title: Grateful Dead Live at Alfred College on 1970-05-01

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a rare early show highlighted by a grin‑inducing performance of “The Race Is On”.
ai_review.review: This recording delivers top‑notch sound quality that fans love, preserving an energetic early‑Dead rendition of the country classic “The Race Is On.” The brief but enthusiastic review underscores both the superb audio fidelity and the fun vibe of the performance.

ai_rating.rationale: A single 5‑star review praises both the musical moment and the recording quality, indicating a highly positive experience; limited sample size keeps confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer explicitly says “Love the quality,” suggesting crisp, clear sound with no noted issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early set includes a lively country cover that adds upbeat energy to the show.
